svg.title: Conversion improvements reported in a speed study

cc:Work.dc:title: Conversion improvements reported in a speed study
cc:Work.dc:description: Historical four-week mobile-site study across selected brands in Europe and the US, commissioned by Google. Reported association with a 0.1-second natural site-speed improvement; not percentage points, a causal guarantee, or an LCP/INP forecast.
